svg.aria-label: Lay out the parts. On parchment, the golem's parts float apart and come back together, and the scroll slides into its head. On a blueprint the same parts are numbered, with a legend: 1 head, the agent loop; 2 torso, the daemon; 3 hips, the protocol; 4 left arm, tools; 5 right arm, MCP; 6 left foot, sessions; 7 right foot, sandboxes; 8 scroll, the model. Each lights up in turn. Below: change one part.
